userPhysicalActivity.physicalActivityShortName: Obliques debout - inclinaison du buste avec 1 bras en haut
userPhysicalActivity.physicalActivityName: Obliques debout - inclinaison du buste avec 1 bras en haut
userPhysicalActivity.guideMeText: Stand with feet shoulder width apart, arms at sides. Extend the right arm overhead and slowly flex laterally to the left, reaching the left arm toward the ground until a stretch is felt in the right side. To deepen the stretch, continue to reach through the extended arm past vertical and toward to the opposite side. Be sure to keep the shoulders square and not to rotate through the hips. Hold the stretch for the desired duration.

userPhysicalActivity.physicalActivityName: Position de l'enfant
userPhysicalActivity.guideMeText: Start in a table top position with the wrists under the shoulders and the knees under the hips. Sink the hips back towards the heels. Lower your body onto your thighs as you extend your arms out in front. Relax the muscles of your neck as you release your forehead towards the floor.
